_about: Extra H1 research candidates per niche and category, tried after the SOP pair ("<category> <town>", "<category> services <town>"). Each term becomes "<term> <town>". "_sitewide" terms are added for the homepage and the location pages. Approved by Brandon, 18 Oct 2026, after a test on Edens Edge (patio installers and decking installers dropped: they scored almost nothing). 19 Oct 2026: gardening services (Gardener) and garden landscaping (Landscape Gardener) added so those services fold into their categories (page map v3). Plurals are not needed: Google Ads returns the same figures for singular and plural. 20 Oct 2026: block paving removed from Paving Contractor: "Block paving" is a service page under the niche library, and a page and its hub should not contest one keyword.
